The cleaner approach is to let the rigid body handle rotation naturally through torque impulses while deriving the forward direction from its actual rotation state, then apply linear impulses in that direction for acceleration. Switching to a kinematic rigid body instead so I can handle all the physics manually—velocity, spring forces, throttle, steering—while letting Rapier just handle collision detection against the track through raycasting.
